Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearBaitEnabled_toolt: Lets players lay out honey or fish as bear bait in or right next to a forest. After one or more nights a cub may come.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearCannotDie_tooltip: Instead of dying, a tamed bear goes down. Help it up, or it gets up on its own after a while.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearCubForestRate: Bear cub: how often in the forest
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearCubForestRate_too: How often an orphaned bear cub appears in or near a forest, out of sight, for a player who has no bear and no cub yet. Chance per in-game hour: rare 2%%, normal 5%%, often 12%%, very often 30%%.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearCubsEnabled_toolt: Main switch. Off: no new bear cubs appear, neither in the forest nor at bait spots. Cubs that are already in the world can still be tamed.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearDamagePercent_too: How hard a tamed bear hits, on top of growing and Fighting. 100 = normal.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearFleeHits: Bear: backs off when this many hits from death
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearFleeHits_tooltip: A tamed bear keeps fighting until its health would last only this many more hits, then it stops and comes back to you. 0 = never backs off.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearGrowDays_tooltip: In-game days from taming until a cub is fully grown (size 1.35). It grows faster at first and slower later; good feeding speeds it up a little. Health, stamina, carrying capacity and damage rise every day with its size.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearHealPercent_toolt: How fast a tamed bear heals on its own. 100 = normal (about 1 percent of its health per in-game hour), 0 = never on its own. Bandages are not affected.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearMaxPerPlayer_tool: How many tamed bears one player may have.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearNeedsPercent_tool: How fast a tamed bear gets hungry, thirsty and tired. 100 = normal, 200 = twice as fast. 0 = off: hunger, thirst and tiredness stay at zero, and it only sleeps next to its sleeping owner. Trust keeps working.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearSkillAgeCap_toolt: A cub learns up to level 3, a half-grown bear up to 6, a strong bear up to 8; only a full-grown bear reaches 10. Experience it already has stays. Off: no limit.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearSkillXpPercent_to: How fast a tamed bear learns its skills. 100 = normal: a skill needs at least about 18 hours of real play time to reach level 10, and with the age limit it stays at 8 or below until the bear is full-grown. 200 = twice as fast.
Sandbox_BanditsNPC_BearTamePercent_toolt: How fast a cub learns to trust you. 100 = normal, 200 = twice as many points per feeding and petting. It still needs at least 3 feedings with a wait in between.
